title: preemptive-aging-kv-aware-scheduler-and-tunable-timeouts-for-continuous-batching
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: We continue to see KV-heavy requests intermittently starving low-throughput, latency-sensitive tails under continuous batching, especially when long sequences and cache repinning events coincide. This PR introduces a KV-aware, preemptive aging mechanism in the continuous-batcher scheduler and exposes tunable timeouts for queue horizons. The goal is to reduce P99 tail latency regressions without sacrificing throughput or introducing unfairness for high-throughput cohorts. Changes are conservative by default and gated behind a feature flag.

Summary of what changed (high-level): Adds a preemption token that ages requests in the queue and allows a small, bounded preemptive window for latency-sensitive cohorts; incorporates KV-cache "pin pressure" signals into preemption weights so requests that will cause cache churn are deprioritized; exposes per-cohort timeout and max-wait config in the batching config; adds tracing + new metrics (batcher_preemptions, batcher_aging_seconds, kv_pin_pressure_score) and dashboard docs; small kernel-level micro-optimizations in the dispatcher hot path to reduce branch mispredictions when the preemption token is active. The overall design attempts to preserve fairness across cohorts while preventing long-tail starvation when KV-heavy requests pile up.

Why this approach: Previous fixes focused on deadline bumping and static priorities which either caused throughput loss or were brittle across mixed workloads. By combining an aging counter with KV-cache awareness we can dynamically adapt preemption pressure only when necessary, and bound the cost via tunable timeouts and a conservative preemption window.

Checklist:
- [x] Scheduler algorithm changes + unit tests
- [x] KV cache integration and safety checks
- [x] Benchmarks (micro and replay)
- [x] Documentation for ops and defaults
- [x] Feature flag + rollout gating
- [x] CI green on main matrix

Risks and mitigations: Preemption adds complexity in the hot path; we keep the fastpath unchanged when the feature flag is off. Default preemption window is small (5ms) and bounded by cohort max-wait. Metrics added to observe regressions; automated canary rollout suggested in PR notes.

Operational notes: Default feature flag is off for existing clusters. Ops can enable on Dedicated/Private progressively and tune cohort_timeouts in the console or via helm values. See docs/ops/batching-tuning.md for recommended knobs and safe rollouts.
commits_summary: 3 commits: initial scheduler and aging token implementation; KV-cache pressure integration and unit tests; docs/bench updates and minor dispatcher micro-optimizations + changelog.
review_thread:

Jonah: 'Nit: small style nits in scheduler.go. Approved after patch.',

ci_matrix: lint: pass; unit: pass; integration: flaky on first run (timeout in integration/docker-compose), rerun passed; perf-bench: pass (provided replay artifacts); e2e: pass on linux/amd64; windows: skipped (not impacted).
bench_results_summary: Replay benchmark (mixed chat + KV-heavy traces): P50 unchanged, P95 ~3% lower, P99 ~12% lower; throughput within 1% of baseline across 3 runs. Small kernel micro-optimizations reduced dispatcher CPU cycles by ~2.1% in microbench. See artifacts: perf/replay/83677/*.
release_notes: Introduce KV-aware preemptive aging in the continuous batcher to reduce P99 tail latency for mixed KV-heavy workloads. New metrics and ops docs. Disabled by default; opt-in rollout recommended.
notes_for_backport: Non-breaking by default (feature flag off). For backports to 1.12.x, ensure the KV pin pressure API matches runtime/kv v1.2 contract. Tests included in patch should be cherry-picked together.
testing_instructions: Enable feature flag (runtime.batcher.preemptive = true) in a canary cluster and run replay with mixed_kv_chat.trace. Observe batcher_preemptions and kv_pin_pressure_score metrics and monitor P99 for the latency-sensitive cohort. Default timeouts are conservative (5ms preemption window, cohort max-wait 50ms).
changelist: Added preemption.go and tests, modified scheduler.go for token handling, new metrics, docs, and helm/defaults. Kept code paths fast when feature is disabled.
security_notes: No new surface for external request handling. All changes orthogonal to auth layer. KV-cache signals are internal metrics only.
post_merge_actions: Rollout to canary group A (10% traffic) for 48h, evaluate metrics then 50% for 24h before full rollout. Add perf regression guard in release pipeline to block if P99 increases >3%.
